BiblicalUsage: Athlai was one of the sons of Bebai who had married a foreign wife, and he put her away when Ezra called the people back to the law. He appears only here.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Athlai's obedience cost him something real, and the record keeps his name because repentance is worth remembering.
